itens.titulo: Goldman Sachs bets on Palantir's 'mega customers' after NYC demo
itens.descricao: Goldman Sachs bets on Palantir's 'mega customers' after NYC demo Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Also read: Palantir's revenue nearly doubled as contract growth slowed Analyst Gabriela Borges kept a Buy rating and a $235 price target.
Palantir customers often expand roughly 18 months into a deployment, according to Goldman.
Disclosed examples have grown five to 15 times in annual contract value, the analysts wrote.
A global athletic company grew from $1.6 million to about $21 million, Goldman said.
A home appliance maker jumped from $1 million to $15 million, according to the note.
An apparel company climbed from $2.5 million to $11.5 million, the analysts added.
commercial revenue per customer now sits near $5 million, Goldman estimated.
Palantir's forward deployed engineers build around a customer's problem, working "backward from the outcome," as Goldman put it.

itens.titulo: Ibovespa registra forte alta de mais de 1% com alívo no dólar e juros futuros
itens.descricao: Ibovespa registra forte alta de mais de 1% com alívo no dólar e juros futuros Exame
trechos: Publicado em 25 de novembro de 2026 às 11h55.
Última atualização em 25 de novembro de 2026 às 17h23.
Por volta das 17h (horário de Brasília), o principal índice acionário da B3 subia 1,55%, aos 166.626 pontos, em tentativa de recuperação após quatro sessões consecutivas de queda.
Na terça-feira, 24, o índice havia fechado em queda de 0,43%, aos 164.089 pontos.

Entre as maiores altas do Ibovespa nesta quarta estão Natura (NATU3), que avança 7,28%, Azzas 2154 (AZZA3), com ganho de 6,91%, Brava Energia (BRAV3), com valorização de 6,71%, Vamos (VAMO3), que sobe 6,59%, e Magazine Luiza (MGLU3), com alta de 6,40%.
Na ponta negativa, Embraer (EMBJ3) lidera as perdas, com queda de 3,71%, pressionada pela proposta dos EUA de tarifa de 10% sobre aeronaves brasileiras.
Na sequência vêm Santander (SANB11), que recua 2,60%, Telefônica Brasil (VIVT3), com baixa de 1,33%, e Marfrig (MBRF3), que cai 1,31%.
Entre as ações de maior peso no índice, a Vale (VALE3) avança 3,48% e recupera parte das perdas da véspera, quando caiu 5,51%.

itens.titulo: Salesforce earnings to put Bank of America’s growth outlook to the test
itens.descricao: Salesforce earnings to put Bank of America’s growth outlook to the test Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM, XETRA:FOO) remains rated "buy" at Bank of America, which sees a favorable short-term outlook for the stock after a roughly 27% decline from its September peak.

The comapny is set to report its fiscal 2027 third-quarter results on December 2, and the bank is looking for signs of faster organic growth in the second half, momentum in cRPO and bookings, and stronger Agentforce monetization.
Bank of America projects Salesforce's organic revenue growth will rise to 7.4% in the third quarter and 9.9% in the fourth, from 6.4% in the second.
The bank also forecasts third-quarter growth of 13.7% in current remaining performance obligations, or cRPO, on a constant-currency basis.
Largely because of higher AI consumption costs, the bank expects third-quarter gross margin to fall 30 basis points and operating margin to fall 110 basis points year over year.
Bank of America's partner checks pointed to muted core seat growth in the calendar third quarter of 2026, while cross-selling and regional rollouts supported higher total contract values.
